verification.expected: Cache-Control: max-age=604800 (7d browser) or higher after rule is live with override origin
notes: Lighthouse flags ~4h TTL when origin returns max-age=14400 (user-photos and event-covers transforms).
cpg-public/hero transforms already return max-age=31536000 — the rule still applies uniformly to all /render/image paths.
Set Edge TTL to override origin (do not use 'respect origin'), otherwise user-photo and event-cover transforms stay at 4h.
cf-cache-status: HIT means Cloudflare edge cached the response; max-age in Cache-Control is what browsers and Lighthouse see.
